title: Stop roaming for what saintly company gives
summary: Restless searching settles when saintly company cools the mind and body. let seeking kneel into saintly company.
takeaway: let seeking kneel into saintly company
lifeApplication: Before starting one more search, stay with the shelter already in front of you and keep one line there.

source.shortMeaning: Restless searching settles when saintly company cools the mind and body.
source.lifeApplication: When the urge to roam returns, stay near the company that brings composure.
